title: Haryana & Rajasthan Sign ₹34,102 Crore Yamuna Water Project Agreement
summary: Resolves 30-year-old inter-state water dispute by conveying 580 MCM water to Shekhawati.

blocks.content: Resolves 30-year-old inter-state water dispute by conveying 580 MCM water to Shekhawati.

items: Project Details: Operationalises 1994 Upper Yamuna River Basin (UYRB) agreement at a cost of ₹34,102 crore.
Conveyance System: 580 million cubic metres (MCM) water piped from Western Yamuna Canal via 3 underground pipelines.
Beneficiary Regions: Supplies drinking water to Sikar, Churu, and Jhunjhunu (Rajasthan) and Bhiwani & Fatehabad (Haryana).

blocks.summary: Special Purpose Vehicle: Rajasthan-Haryana Yamuna Water SPV (RHYW-SPV) formed for execution.
